_note: Built-in finance preset (advisory / wealth / brokerage assistants). Enable with VAYL_SLOT_SCHEMA=preset:finance and VAYL_CRITICAL_CATEGORIES=critical so KYC and risk tolerance are always surfaced. KYC and risk changes always wait for a person — an LLM reading a chat line is not a client instruction to change them. Holdings and account type are confirm "auto": a clear change applies at once, an uncertain one waits.

slots.name: kyc_status
slots.description: the client's KYC / AML verification status

slots.name: risk_tolerance
slots.description: the client's stated risk tolerance (e.g. conservative, moderate, aggressive)

slots.name: investment_holding
slots.description: a security the client currently holds, with quantity (a portfolio is a list)

slots.name: financial_goal
slots.description: a financial goal the client is working toward (a client may have several)

slots.name: account_type
slots.description: the client's account type or tier
